services.title: The right solar solution for your needs
services.intro: Rooftop, ground-mount, agrivoltaics, carport and energy storage — five solar solutions, sized to your needs and delivered turnkey.

rooftop.desc: We turn your industrial and commercial rooftops into turnkey solar plants — from survey to commissioning, all under one roof.

ground.desc: Got land? We build your unlicensed plant end to end, from field to transformer.

agripv.desc: Two harvests from one field — power up top, crops below: Agri-PV for greenhouses and farmland.

carport.desc: Put the car park to work: shade and power overhead, EV charging below.

bess.desc: Lithium storage that clocks in when the sun clocks out — carry your energy from noon into the night.

how.title: From survey to operation, step by step
how.intro: A transparent, six-step process. You always know what comes next.

discovery.title: Free Survey
discovery.desc: We assess your roof, consumption and needs on site, and advise you.

engineering.title: Engineering & Feasibility
engineering.desc: We count every kWh before the first shovel: PVsyst simulation, irradiance analysis and site survey.

licensing.title: Permitting & Licensing
licensing.desc: Leave the red tape to us — EPDK filings, DSO applications and the grid-connection letter, start to finish.

procurement.title: Procurement
procurement.desc: Only the good stuff reaches site: panels, inverters, cables (DC/AC/MV), mounting structures, distribution boards and switchgear — sourced for you.

install.title: Install & Commission
install.desc: Fast, safe installation by fully-equipped crews with airtight HSE; testing, permits and net-metering are on us.

om.title: Monitoring & Maintenance (O&M)
om.desc: We stick around after switch-on: 24/7 remote monitoring, scheduled maintenance and a performance guarantee.

areas.title: A solution for every scale
areas.intro: From individual homes to industrial facilities — systems that scale to your needs.

konut.title: Residential
konut.desc: Turnkey rooftop solar for villas and detached homes.

ticari.title: Commercial & Industrial
ticari.desc: High-capacity energy solutions for businesses and industrial zones.

tarim.title: Agricultural
tarim.desc: Sustainable energy for irrigation and farming operations.

kamu.title: Public & Institutional
kamu.desc: Scalable, reliable systems for institutions and public projects.

calc.title: Bring your bill close to zero
calc.desc: With a few details, estimate your system size, annual savings and payback period.
calc.note: Results are estimates; create a free survey for a precise quote.
calc.point1: Results in 2 minutes from your bill and city
calc.point2: kWp, cost range and payback period

products.title: Only the best reaches your site
products.intro: Every component we install comes from tier-1 manufacturers. TOPCon N-Type panels, dependable inverters and up to 30 years of performance warranty — your system is built to run for decades.

t1.quote: Everything was transparent from survey to install. Our bill really did drop to almost zero.
t1.name: Ayşe K.

t2.quote: The team was very professional; installation finished on time, without a hitch.
t2.name: Mehmet D.

t3.quote: With energy storage we use our own energy at night too. We're delighted.
t3.name: Zeynep A.

cost.a: Cost depends on system size, roof type and chosen equipment. We give you a clear range during the free survey.

payback.a: For residential systems payback is usually within a few years; estimate it with the calculator based on your usage and tariffs.

warranty.q: What do warranty and service cover?
warranty.a: Manufacturer warranty on panels and equipment, workmanship warranty on installation, and after-sales maintenance support.

incentives.q: How do incentives and net-metering work?
incentives.a: Excess energy you produce can be fed to the grid and offset against your bill; we manage the relevant permit processes.

finalCta.title: Invest in your energy future today
finalCta.desc: Create a free survey and we'll bring you a tailored savings and system proposal.
finalCta.waMessage: Hello, I'd like to get a free survey from MİNADA.

intro.rest: — we design, build and operate your energy transition under one roof.
intro.muted: From survey to commissioning the whole process is on us; you just enjoy the sun.

home.metaDesc: Turnkey solar for villas and detached homes: up to 90% bill savings, net-metering and 25-year panel life.
home.title: Let your home make its own energy
home.intro: Turnkey solar for your villa or detached home. Your bill drops, your comfort rises — and your home becomes a harbor that powers itself.

b1.title: Up to 90% savings
b1.desc: Your electricity bill falls close to zero with the sun; rising tariffs stop touching you.

b2.title: Net-metering
b2.desc: Energy you don't use is fed to the grid and offset against your bill. We manage the permits.

b3.title: 25-year panel life
b3.desc: Panels run under performance warranties of 25 years and beyond; the system pays for itself within a few years.

home.stepsTitle: The road to your roof: 6 steps
home.stepsIntro: From survey to switch-on, every step is on us — you just enjoy the sun.

business.metaDesc: Rooftop, ground-mount, Agri-PV, carport and energy storage for businesses: lower OPEX, fast payback, unlicensed generation.
business.title: Turn your energy cost into an investment
business.intro: From factories to farms, car parks to warehouses — we size the right solar solution for your business, build it turnkey and operate it.

b1.title: Lower OPEX
b1.desc: Your electricity spend shrinks line by line; production costs become predictable.

b2.title: Fast payback
b2.desc: Commercial systems pay for themselves quickly on high consumption; after that it's net gain.

b3.title: Unlicensed generation
b3.desc: Generate your own power under the unlicensed scheme and offset the surplus. We handle the applications.

business.solutionsNote: Not sure which fits? Let's pin it down together in a free survey.
